column1: # Authored expectation for the Phase-18 test-surface join.
# Section S clause 2: the run enumerates its test surfaces and joins them completely to an
# independently authored expectation. This file replaces the retired committed enumeration,
# which was a generated projection of the gate rather than an opinion the gate is checked
# owner is the registry the ids are enumerated from at run time:
#   items     the validation-locus entries and mutant names the run read
#   checks    the check ids tools/ui_authorization_gate.py implements
# The 30 items are partitioned so each is claimed exactly once. A rejection surface takes
# both halves of its evidence where both exist — the pinned row that must be refused and
# the generated class that must keep firing at its coverage floor — because a foreclosure a
# single hand-picked row decides is a foreclosure one edit can hollow out.
# The two mutants keep their own surfaces rather than riding the foreclosures they attack.
# That is this phase's contract vocabulary, and it keeps the distinction visible: the pinned
# row proves the refusal happens, the mutant proves the check that refuses has teeth, and a
# reader can see which of the two went missing.
